remarks: This house is in need of some tender loving care, but it has so much potential. With a buildable lot next door, 2 Finley Street,MLS listing #24067604, the possibilities are endless. Bring your ideas and turn this house into your forever home. Whether you're looking to renovate and update the existing space or build something new on the empty lot, this property is just waiting for someone to come in and make it their own. If you're in the medical field - walk to Norwalk Hospital, all major highways are right there, shopping, entertainment and restaurants - walk or drive. Don't miss out on this opportunity to create the home of your dreams.
